facts.fact: Maddy 的「破碎之年」：缝纫厂倒闭、父亲摔伤、航空罢工、AIM 来客接连不断。
facts.anchor: The entire year—the sewing factory closing, her dad’s fall, the airline strike, and a covey of AIM visitors—seemed like one long issue of People magazine.

facts.fact: 她 82 岁的父亲摔下地下室楼梯，骨盆骨折——他自己形容为「靴子翻过脑袋」。
facts.anchor: SHE HAD NOT been present when her eighty-two-year-old dad tumbled down the basement stairs—“boots over noggin,” as he described it.

facts.fact: 工厂最后一个工作日，好友 Eileen 拥抱道别：「以后只能靠狼烟联系了。」
facts.anchor: On their last workday, during the last hug, her niijikwe Eileen said, “We’ll have to use smoke signals now,”

facts.fact: 父亲拒绝穿越航空公司罢工的警戒线，宁愿开五个半小时夜车去双城看病。
facts.anchor: “Dammit to hell, Maddy. I can’t cross the picket line.”

facts.fact: Maddy 自称「众神的情人」：火圈、小教堂、汗屋她都进，向每一个小精灵献礼物。
facts.anchor: She was a god whore. She had entered fire circles, chapels, and sweat lodges.

facts.fact: 圣安东尼教堂的临时神父是退休的 Adolph Reilly，年迈却在弥撒中一丝不苟。
facts.anchor: They learned he was Father Adolph Reilly, retired and only filling in while the regular priest was on sabbatical.

facts.fact: 圣灰星期三上她手忙脚乱，导致神父把圣灰洒得到处都是——额头、鼻子、下巴、胸口全有。
facts.anchor: She ended up marked on her forehead, her nose, her chin, and her chest.

facts.fact: 汗屋导师 Chibenashi 在她说完「就像这一切」后突然吻了她。
facts.anchor: Stood, looked long at her as if he were angry, bent slightly, and kissed her, then repeated her words in a low voice, “Like all this.”

facts.fact: 年末 Maddy 与 Eileen、Chibenashi 一起写《保留地抵抗》通讯，父亲主动徒步投递。
facts.anchor: She and Eileen had joined Chibenashi in writing a Rez Resistance newsletter. Her dad had offered to deliver it—by foot,
